headline: US Pushes to Restore Russian Gas Sales to Europe via Ukraine
summary: The U.S. is backing a quick resumption of Russian natural gas sales to Europe via pipelines running through Ukraine as part of negotiations for an energy ceasefire ahead of winter.
why: Europe's energy supply stability and natural gas pricing heavily depend on pipeline flows and geopolitical negotiations involving Russian exports.
why_moved: News of potential pipeline flows and energy ceasefires directly impacts European gas supply expectations and commodity pricing.
